The system we are building.

Work, structured.

We are building two web apps: one where our customers log in, and one where we run the work. This document explains the whole thing in plain language, then asks you to check it.

Nothing here is final. If something reads wrong to you, say so — that is exactly what this is for.

How to fill this in

  1. Read as you go. Every chapter explains itself before it asks anything. No prior knowledge needed.
  2. Answer honestly, not diplomatically. A disagreement caught now costs nothing. Caught later it costs weeks.
  3. The notes box under each question matters more than the options. Write freely — examples, worries, "it depends".
  4. Skipping is fine. If a question is not your area, leave it.
  5. Your answers save automatically in this browser. Close it, come back later, carry on.
  6. When you are done, press Download my answers at the bottom and send the file back.

That is everything. Press Download my answers below, and send the file back. Thank you — this is the part that makes the build come out right.
